description.value: Hooper's Bakery is a small-batch specialty bakery in the Kootenays, BC, producing and selling artisan baked goods from its own production facility and retail storefront. Cyclists can browse in person or pre-order online for a quick, prepaid pickup at a dedicated back-door pickup window. The bakery markets itself as 'Distinctive and Bold' and has an active local following.

address.value: 2042 Columbia Avenue PBX 2452, Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0, Canada
